M-IMPACT.NAME: Change impact analysis
M-IMPACT.purpose: Map changed files to affected modules, transitive dependents, verification blast radius and phases, and suggest the proving commands (Wave 3.3).

CrossLink.relation: module entries and dependents come from the shard-transparent union
suggested commands reuse the trust-gated verification plan

contract.purpose: Answer "what does this change affect?" for an agent or CI job without reading every entity file.

param.name: files
param.description: Comma-separated project-relative changed files (works without git).

param.name: since
param.description: Git revision to diff against (default HEAD).

param.name: result
param.description: files, directModules, dependents, verificationStatus, affectedPhases, suggestedCommands, notes.

error.description: No changed-file source available (no git and no --files) — exit 2.
Changed files map to no indexed module (info; exit 0).

notes.note-1: Read-only and argv-only: git is spawned without a shell, with a 2 s timeout; everything degrades gracefully outside a checkout.
notes.note-2: Direct modules are matched by exact PATH, module-directory prefix, or docs entity edits; dependents are the transitive reverse DEPENDS closure.
notes.note-3: Suggested commands include a `mygrace trust` note when the verification plan is untrusted, scoped `mygrace verify --module …` and the final `mygrace ci`.
